newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana shaken by penis snatcher riots, two lynched.
newsitem.headline: Ghana shaken by penis snatcher riots, two lynched.

text.p: Mobs in Ghana's capital Accra beat to death two men accused of snatching penises by witchcraft in order to extort cash in return for a cure, police said on Friday.
The disturbances, in which at least six other suspected penis shrinkers were seriously injured on Thursday, spread to the port of Tema on Friday where police prevented a similar lynching.
Victims say sorcerers simply touched them to make their genitals shrink or disappear.
Police and government have dismissed the disturbances as the work of thieves, who spread rumours to create a crowd and pick pockets.

Accra's deputy police commissioner, Kwashievie Agbelie, told state television police examined all victims and found their genitals intact. "It is a ploy by confidence tricksters to create a crowd so that they can rob them," he said.
Armed police deployed in parts of Accra on Friday to prevent trouble.
Such reports are not uncommon in West Africa, with purported victims often blaming handshakes with sorcerers.
